subject: Welcome Project Immigrant Assistance
overview: The Welcome Project presented an overview of its mission and the severe economic and health impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic on immigrant families in the Somerville area. The organization requested community support through donations to its Immigrant Assistance Fund and called for bilingual volunteers to assist with outreach.

items.title: Mission of The Welcome Project
items.summary: Kenia Alfaro explained that the organization works to empower immigrant families in Somerville and Metro North Boston through English classes, youth programs, and community advocacy.

items.title: COVID-19 Impact on Immigrant Communities
items.summary: Alfaro described the disproportionate impact of the pandemic on immigrant families, noting record levels of job loss, food insecurity, and high infection rates among Central American, Haitian, and Brazilian residents.

items.title: Assistance Fund and Volunteer Opportunities
items.summary: The organization solicited donations for its Immigrant Assistance Fund to provide rental and utility aid and requested volunteers fluent in Spanish, Portuguese, or Haitian Creole to assist with outreach.
